item.title: Indian River Sheriff says two deaths near Sebastian River Bridge not connected
item.description: Two bodies found within two days near the Sebastian River bridge are not connected, according to the Indian River County Sheriff.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names ahead of August debut
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League released the nicknames and logos of its four teams Wednesday, with each team name inspired by pioneering women.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff to reach Wimbledon final in dramatic tiebreaker
